title: Cursed Papilion (Cursed Fate Addon)
description: This mod adds a custom technique to the Jujutsu Kaisen: Cursed Fate Mod
body:
Cursed Papilion is a Custom Techniques that has the ability to rival Limitless or Shrine in strength

it mainly deals with taking your opponents or your own cursed energy and fueling attacks that way. also it deals with alot of butterflies and explosives

NOTE: the mob griefing stops this technique from griefing your world, also the open domain will have a mod coming out by someone. that mod makes the open domain function properly.

# Ability 1: Butterfly Swarm

User sends a swarm of Butterflies made of Cursed Energy these Butterflies explode on contact

Flow: More Butterflies

# Ability 2: Butterfly Migration

User sends an extremely large swarm of butterflies that fly in all directions a period of time, anything with cursed energy for touching the butterflies, causes the Butterflies to explode.

Flow: makes the migration last longer

Maximum Output: Homing butterflies

# Ability 3: Butterfly Flight

User flings themselves using cursed energy

# Ability 4: Pavilion

Sets up a simple domain around User. Any cursed energy close to User turns into butterflies. Including the cursed energy inside of someone.

Flow: More Butterflies

Maximum Output: Cursed Webs: Cursed Webs that weakening those caught

(this has a secret move)

# Ability 5: Maximum Output: Wings of Grace

User Grows wings, and unlocks max version of their ablilties

# Ability 6: Domain Expansion: Thieving Garden Willow
Incomplete: all in area who are touching the domain, will get their CE Siphoned and damaged

Open Barrier: Siphons CE from all in the radius, and releases a enormous swarm of butterflies


stay larping!
